intro: The Society's property portfolio spans Abuja and other Nigerian cities, delivered with appointed developers under project agreements. Pricing, availability and delivery schedules are confirmed by the Secretariat on enquiry.

projects.name: AG Mortgage Homes, Asaba
projects.summary: A home ownership project in Asaba, Delta State, offered to members under the Coop Home Ownership and Asset Acquisition Scheme.
description: AG Mortgage Homes is one of the Society's property projects and is offered to members through the Coop Home Ownership and Asset Acquisition Scheme.
The scheme provides affordable housing and financial assistance under flexible payment plans which may extend to the end of the project.
Members interested in this project should request the current schedule, payment plan and title documentation position from the Secretariat before committing funds.

projects.name: Kaduna Project
projects.summary: A residential project in Kaduna State delivered through the Society's developer partnerships.
description: The Kaduna project forms part of the Society's property portfolio and is delivered with an appointed developer under a project agreement.
Members are advised to confirm unit availability, pricing and delivery timelines with the Secretariat, as these are project-specific and confirmed in writing.
Finance for qualifying members may be arranged through the Society's home ownership scheme.

projects.name: Baden Moyet, Okota
projects.summary: A residential development at Okota, Lagos State, available to members of the Society.
description: Baden Moyet is a Society property project located at Okota in Lagos State.
The project is offered to members through the home ownership scheme, with payment plans structured across the life of the project.
Current availability, pricing and documentation are provided by the Secretariat on enquiry.

projects.name: Katampe Project
projects.summary: A residential project at Katampe in the Federal Capital Territory.
description: The Katampe project is part of the Society's Abuja property portfolio.
Members should request the current project schedule and payment plan from the Secretariat before subscribing.
Delivery timelines and title documentation are confirmed per project in the project agreement.

projects.name: Jikwoyi Project
projects.summary: A residential project at Jikwoyi in the Federal Capital Territory.
description: The Jikwoyi project is offered to members under the Society's home ownership scheme.
Members interested in the project should contact the Secretariat for the current availability, pricing and payment plan.
Where applicable, access to the National Housing Fund is facilitated by the developer as contained in the project agreement.

projects.name: Asokoro Project
projects.summary: A residential project at Asokoro in the Federal Capital Territory.
description: The Asokoro project sits within the Society's Abuja portfolio and is available to members on enquiry.
Pricing, unit types and delivery schedules are confirmed by the Secretariat.
Members should review the project documentation before committing funds.

projects.name: Guzape Project
projects.summary: A residential project at Guzape in the Federal Capital Territory.
description: The Guzape project forms part of the Society's property portfolio in Abuja.
Members should request the current project schedule, payment plan and documentation from the Secretariat.
The Society confirms all terms in writing before any subscription is made.
